Smooths out uneven frame delivery by adjusting how far ahead frames are buffered and occasionally dropping bunched frames when the network jitters. Adds a little latency in exchange for steadier motion on unstable connections. Applies to Remote Play, Game Library and Game Catalog.

Sharpens the stream image in real time using AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening
Enable AMD FidelityFX upscaling and sharpening

If the stream is set to 720p and Upscaling is enabled, it will upscale to 1080p. If the stream is set to 1080p and Upscaling is enabled, it will upscale to 1440p. Please note: if your device’s maximum resolution is 1080p, Android will downsample the 1440p output to 1080p, which can cause a blurry image. In this situation, leave Upscaling disabled.
Restore the default stream and image-processing values
1080p stream → 1440p output; this %1$dp display will downsample it and may look softer. If this is the case, please leave Upscaling disabled.
Stream settings below restart the stream when applied
Image processing and sharpening apply immediately during a stream. Resolution, frame rate, bitrate and codec apply after restarting the stream.
